name: lucid-eld
description: Reads DriveHOS/Lucid ELD Partner API v2 company, driver, vehicle, latest status, and vehicle location history data through bounded read-only GET endpoints. The official API surface documents no mutations, reports, webhooks, or binary/media operations.

risk.read: read-only DriveHOS/Lucid ELD Partner API GET requests can return company, driver, vehicle, latest status, and vehicle location history data; outputs are bounded and secret-shaped fields are redacted by generic policies
